simplified_text:
An application under this Act cannot be rejected because of a mistake, something missing, or something done incorrectly in the application. This includes mistakes in the affidavit required under subsection (1), the summons issued under it, or in other proceedings before or during an inquiry under this Act.

However, the application can be rejected if the mistake, omission, or irregularity has caused serious harm to one of the parties involved.
